sentences.en: The suffragette movement, which campaigned for votes for women in the early twentieth century, is most commonly associated with the Pankhurst family and militant acts of varying degrees of violence.
sentences.zh: 20世纪初为妇女争取选票的女选民运动,与潘克赫斯特家族和不同程度暴力的好战行为最经常有关。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The Museum of London has drawn on its archive collection to convey a fresh picture with its exhibition.
sentences.zh: 伦敦博物馆利用其档案收藏,以展出一幅新的图片。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The name is a reference to the colour scheme that the Women’s Social and Political Union (WSPU) created to give the movement a uniform, nationwide image.
sentences.zh: 名称是指妇女社会和政治联盟(妇女联盟)为该运动提供统一、全国形象而建立的彩色计划。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By doing so, it became one of the first groups to project a corporate identity, and it is this advanced marketing strategy, along with the other organisational and commercial achievements of the WSPU, to which the exhibition is devoted.
sentences.zh: 这样做,它成为第一批预测公司身份的团体之一,这是这一先进的营销战略,以及该展览所专用于的WSPU的其他组织和商业成就。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Formed in 1903 by the political campaigner Mrs. Emmeline Pankhurst and her daughters Christabel and Sylvia, the WSPU began an educated campaign to put women’s suffrage on the political agenda.
sentences.zh: 妇女和平联盟于1903年成立, 由政治运动家Emmeline Pankhurst夫人及女儿Christabel及Sylvia组成,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: New Zealand, Australia and parts of the United States had already enfranchised women, and growing numbers of their British counterparts wanted the same opportunity.
sentences.zh: 新西兰、澳大利亚和美国部分地区已经给予妇女以选举权,越来越多的英国同行希望获得同样的机会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: With their slogan ‘Deeds not words’, and the introduction of the colour scheme, the WSPU soon brought the movement the cohesion and focus it had previously lacked.
sentences.zh: 他们的口号是「不是文字, 而是言词」, 加上肤色计划,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Membership grew rapidly as women deserted the many other, less directed, groups and joined it.
sentences.zh: 随着妇女抛弃许多其他不太直接的团体,加入进来,成员迅速增加。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: By 1906 the WSPU headquarters, called the Women’s Press Shop, had been established in Charing Cross Road and in spite of limited communications (no radio or television, and minimal use of the telephone) the message had spread around the country, with members and branch officers stretching to as far away as Scotland.
sentences.zh: 到1906年,在Charing Cross路建立了WSPU总部,称为妇女新闻商店,尽管通信有限(没有广播或电视,而且电话使用很少),但该信息已在全国传播,其成员和分处官员的距离远至苏格兰。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The newspapers produced by the WSPU, first Votes for Women and later The Suffragette, played a vital role in this communication.
sentences.zh: 妇女社会促进联盟制作的报纸《妇女第一选票》和后来的《人民革命报》在这份来文中发挥了重要作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Both were sold throughout the country and proved an invaluable way of informing members of meetings, marches, fund-raising events and the latest news and views on the movement.
sentences.zh: 这两件物品都在全国出售,证明是向会议、游行、筹款活动成员通报有关该运动的最新消息和观点的宝贵方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Equally importantly for a rising political group, the newspaper returned a profit.
sentences.zh: 报纸也带来利润,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This was partly because advertising space was bought in the paper by large department stores such as Selfridges, and jewellers such as Mappin & Webb.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是报纸上购买了广告空间,如Selfridges等大型百货商店和Mappin & Webb等珠宝商。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: These two, together with other likeminded commercial enterprises sympathetic to the cause, had quickly identified a direct way to reach a huge market of women, many with money to spend.
sentences.zh: 这两家企业以及同情这一事业的其他志同道合的商业企业,很快找到了直接进入妇女市场的途径,其中许多妇女有钱花钱。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The creation of the colour scheme provided another money-making opportunity which the WSPU was quick to exploit.
sentences.zh: 建立彩色计划提供了另一个赚钱的机会,而WSPU很快就能利用这一机会。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The group began to sell playing cards, board games, Christmas and greeting cards, and countless other goods, all in the purple, white and green colours.
sentences.zh: 该集团开始出售扑克牌、棋盘游戏、圣诞节和贺卡,以及无数其他商品,全部是紫色、白色和绿色。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In 1906 such merchandising of a corporate identity was a new marketing concept.
sentences.zh: 1906年,这种公司身份的商业化是一种新的营销概念。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But the paper and merchandising activities alone did not provide sufficient funds for the WSPU to meet organisational costs, so numerous other fund-raising activities combined to fill the coffers of the ‘war chest’.
sentences.zh: 但光靠报纸和商品商品交易活动, 不足以让WSPU承担组织成本,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The most notable of these was the Woman’s Exhibition, which took place in 1909 in a Knightsbridge ice-skating rink, and in 10 days raised the equivalent of £250,000 today.
sentences.zh: 其中最引人注目的是1909年在奈茨桥冰冰冰冰场举行的妇女展览,10天后今天筹集到相当于25万英镑的金额。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The Museum of London’s exhibition is largely visual, with a huge number of items on show.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Against a quiet background hum of street sounds, copies of The Suffragette, campaign banners and photographs are all on display, together with one of Mrs. Pankhurst’s shoes and a number of purple, white and green trinkets.
sentences.zh: 照片、竞选旗帜和照片, 连同潘克赫斯特夫人的鞋子及一些紫色、白色和绿色的纹身。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Photographs depict vivid scenes of a suffragette’s life: WSPU members on a selfproclaimed ‘monster’ march, wearing their official uniforms of a white frock decorated with purple, white and green accessories; women selling The Suffragette at street corners, or chalking up pavements with details of a forthcoming meeting.
sentences.zh: 照片描绘了一位女选民生动的一生:在自封的`怪物'游行中,女选民党员穿着白花花的正式制服,上面装饰着紫色、白色和绿色的饰物;妇女在街角卖《苏弗拉格特》,或用即将举行的会议的细节把人行道弄得一团糟。

sentences.en: Windows display postcards and greeting cards designed by women artists for the movement, and the quality of the artwork indicates the wealth of resources the WSPU could call on from its talented members.
sentences.zh: 视窗显示女艺术家为运动设计的明信片和贺卡,艺术作品的质量表明,妇女和平联盟可以从其有才能的成员那里得到大量资源。

sentences.en: Visitors can watch a short film made up of old newsreels and cinema material which clearly reveals the political mood of the day towards the suffragettes.

sentences.en: Although the exhibition officially charts the years 1906 to 1914, graphic display boards outlining the bills of enfranchisement of 1918 and 1928, which gave the adult female populace of Britain the vote, show what was achieved.

sentences.en: It demonstrates how advanced the suffragettes were in their thinking, in the marketing of their campaign, and in their work as shrewd and skillful image-builders.

sentences.en: It also conveys a sense of the energy and ability the suffragettes brought to their fight for freedom and equality.
